image_description: A bathroom scene featuring a wall-mounted chrome toilet paper holder with a roll of white toilet paper on the left, and a small white trash can containing used tissue on the right. The floor is tiled with beige squares, and the walls are off-white.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Soft, thin, absorbent paper wound into cylindrical roll around cardboard tube.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object on the wall is clearly a cylindrical roll of paper. While the core is not directly visible due to the angle and fullness of the roll, the geometry is consistent with a standard roll.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Roll is compact with modest diameter and width, suitable for standard bathroom holder.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The proportions of the roll relative to the holder and the wall suggest standard dimensions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Individual sheets perforated for easy tearing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The resolution and lighting do not allow for the visualization of micro-perforations on the paper surface.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Slightly textured, embossed surface pattern (quilted or dotted).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Surface texture details like embossing are below the resolution threshold of the image; the paper appears smooth due to lighting blur.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Cardboard core visible at center of roll.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The roll is viewed from the side/front, and the paper extends fully to the edge, occluding the central hole/core.
The paper is distinctly white, contrasting with the warmer tones of the wall and floor.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Matte, fibrous texture with visible paper fibers at close range.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Image resolution is insufficient to resolve individual paper fibers.
Separation lines are not visible at this distance and resolution.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Household paper product in roll format.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The context (bathroom, holder) and shape confirm it is a household paper roll.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The used tissue in the trash can lacks distinct fibrous texture and appears as a smooth, melted white mass rather than crumpled paper.
The bottom edge of the hanging paper strip blends slightly into the wall shadow, lacking a crisp physical boundary.
The elliptical perspective of the trash can rim seems slightly inconsistent with the floor tile perspective, appearing slightly warped.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the primary subject is correctly classified as toilet tissue and not a similar cylindrical object.
To verify the physical continuity of the paper strip and ensure no fusion with the wall or holder.
To assess overall image coherence, lighting consistency, and detect subtle generative artifacts in the background.

focus_areas: Boundary sharpness between the paper roll and the wall
Texture realism of the paper surface vs. AI smoothing
Geometric consistency of the holder mounting
Physical plausibility of the crumpled tissue in the bin
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'melted' appearance of the tissue in the trash can, which is a common AI artifact where complex crumpled structures fail to resolve. Also, check if the paper strip hanging from the roll has a physically valid connection point to the roll itself.
